recipes.oracle_text: Other Kithkin creatures you control get +1/+1.

recipe_coverage: Explicit positive continuous boost component, pinned to full Oracle passive text. Tests controller/type/color/artifact scope, matching and nonmatching permanents, self-exclusion, both players, tapped/sick sources, casting and payment, stacking, source removal/re-entry, blink, temporary pump interaction, combat, cleanup, populated zones and snapshots replayed after AI backups. Separately printed activated abilities, Flash timing, type/color changes, control changes, negative modifiers, additional passive clauses and multiplayer are gaps. Not whole-card certification.
